description: Open HTML files in your default browser from the Explorer, the editor, or with a double-click. Detects the default browser on macOS, Windows, and Linux.
command.open.title: Open in Browser
config.title: Open HTML in Browser
config.browser.description: Browser used to open HTML files. `default` detects the operating system's default browser.
config.browser.default: The operating system's default browser (detected automatically).
config.browser.chrome: Google Chrome. On Linux, Chromium is used when Chrome is not installed.
config.customBrowserPath.description: Full path to the browser executable, used when `#openHtmlInBrowser.browser#` is `custom`. On macOS an `.app` bundle can also be given.
config.openOnDoubleClick.description: Open HTML files in the browser when they are double-clicked in the Explorer. A single click still opens the file in the text editor.
config.alsoOpenInEditor.description: When an HTML file is double-clicked in the Explorer, open it in the text editor as well as in the browser.
